# dokku_app (Resource)

Manages a Dokku application. This resource enables the configuration and deployment of applications on a Dokku host, supporting environment variables, domains, buildpacks, port mapping, and deploying from a Docker image via `from_image`.

## Example Usage

### Basic app

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "rails-app" {
  name = "rails-app"

  config_vars = {
    AWS_REGION = "eu-west-2"
  }

  domains = [
    "test.dokku.me"
  ]
}
```

### Deploy from a Docker image

Deploy an app from an existing Docker image using Dokku's [`git:from-image`](https://dokku.com/docs/deployment/methods/image/):

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "posthog" {
  name       = "posthog"
  from_image = "posthog/posthog:release-1.33.0"

  domains = [
    "posthog.example.com"
  ]
}
```

When `from_image` is set, the provider runs `git:from-image` after creating/configuring the app so the container is deployed. Changing the value re-deploys with the new image. Private images require `registry:login` on the Dokku host beforehand.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Dokku application.

### Optional

- `buildpacks` (List of String) List of buildpacks to be used when deploying the application. These can be URLs to custom buildpacks or shorthand names for official Heroku buildpacks.
- `config_vars` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables to set for the application. These are exposed to the application at runtime.
- `domains` (Set of String) List of domains to be associated with the application.
- `from_image` (String) Docker image to deploy the app from via `git:from-image` (e.g. `posthog/posthog:release-1.33.0`). When set, the app is deployed from this image. Private registries require prior `registry:login` on the Dokku host.
- `locked` (Boolean) (Not yet implemented) Whether the application is locked for deployment. When true, deploys to this application will be blocked.
- `nginx_bind_address_ipv4` (String) The IPv4 address that nginx will bind to for this application. Defaults to '0.0.0.0'.
- `nginx_bind_address_ipv6` (String) The IPv6 address that nginx will bind to for this application. Defaults to '::'.
- `ports` (Set of String) Set of port mappings for the application. Each mapping should be in the format 'scheme:hostPort:containerPort' (e.g., 'https:443:8080').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
